mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strengthening supply side, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which lowers borrowing costs and increases corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in one month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a strong demand environment and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and UNRATE decreases > 0.3%
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases by more than 10% YoY and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 2% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) growth remains positive, it signals a tightening supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY and INDPRO growth > 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is less than 2% YoY and INDPRO growth remains positive.
